changelog: Say "capitalize samir" — or "samir বড় হাতের করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and that word is capitalised wherever it sits in the message; "lowercase Department" does the reverse. Gboard's Pixel 8+ "Capitalize [word]" / "Lowercase [word]" commands, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali — the fix for a name or title dictated lowercase mid-sentence.
